7+ years of professional quality engineering, software test automation, or equivalent engineering experience

Experience with Playwright test runner concepts such as fixtures, setup hooks, assertions, projects, grep filtering, traces, screenshots, and HTML reports
Experience testing REST APIs, including HTTP methods, status codes, headers, JSON payloads, authentication tokens, and response assertions
Experience with test data management, including seeding, cleanup, deterministic setup, and avoiding reliance on unknown pre-existing state

Experience with microservices architectures, APIs, and data-intensive systems, validating large datasets and pipelines.
Deep expertise in test strategies, methodologies, and automation at scale.

Technical Leadership & Quality Strategy

Working on cutting edge programmatic ad tech that touches millions of users every single day.

Drive shift-left testing and quality-by-design principles, influencing system architecture for testability and reliability.

Design and build scalable, reusable automation frameworks and test infrastructure.
Develop tools that enable teams to independently own, measure, and continuously improve quality.

Enable data validation, observability-driven testing, and production validation strategies.

Partner with Engineering, Product, Platform, and DevOps teams to ensure high-quality releases by enforcing quality standards and best practices.
Influence design and architecture decisions to improve scalability, performance, and testability.
Identify systemic gaps and drive across engineering improvements in testing practices and tooling.
Standardize quality metrics, reporting, and release quality gates across teams
Drive improvements in production quality, incident reduction, and system resilience

Mentor and coach engineers on test design, automation, tooling and quality best practices.
Raise engineering standards through code reviews, design reviews, and technical guidance.

Foster a culture of ownership, learning, and high engineering standards.
